name: jianying-edit
description: Turn edit-plan JSON into native, fully editable JianYing Pro drafts via a deterministic headless engine — multi-track video/text/audio, non-destructive, verified.

interface.shortDescription: Edit-plan JSON to native JianYing drafts
interface.longDescription: Generate native, fully editable JianYing Pro drafts from edit-plan JSON through a deterministic headless engine: multi-track video/text/audio assembly, non-destructive generation with replace gates, draft-root detection on macOS and Windows, and verbatim-vendored engine with digest manifest. Drafts open in 剪映 as normal projects for fine-tuning and export.
